day_shape: 44 items: OFAC indefinitely suspends five Iran general licences, IDF claims 400+ south Lebanon sites dismantled, UN Security Council Palestine briefing, Iran International reports fuel reserves near depletion, heavy IRGC/IRIB messaging on Strait of Hormuz and 'hostile media' targeting.

threads.label: OFAC tightens Iran sanctions regime
threads.summary: The US Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control indefinitely suspended five general licences issued under the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations. IRIB reposted a Telegraph piece arguing Trump's economic campaign against Iran is 'doomed to fail'.

threads.label: IDF operations in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said it had dismantled over 400 terror infrastructure sites and seized anti-tank and surface-to-air missiles in southern Lebanon's Security Zone, and struck a Hamas ambush position in Jabalia near Kamal Adwan Hospital and a school. Palestinian media reported one dead in an Israeli strike on a tent in Khan Younis; the UN Security Council held its 10214th meeting on the Middle East/Palestine.

threads.label: IRGC messaging on Hormuz and hostile media
threads.summary: IRGC spokesperson Brigadier Mohebbian claimed on Defa Press that America 'dropped to its knees' seeking to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and had requested NATO and European help. Armed forces spokesperson Brigadier Shokarcheh told a Sacred Defence News Agency event that BBC Persian, Iran International and Radio Farda are in Iran's 'military target bank'.

threads.label: IAEA access and nuclear-site inspections
threads.summary: The head of Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation said on IRIB that the IAEA cannot inspect nuclear sites until an inspection protocol is drawn up for attacked facilities, accusing the Agency of undermining its own authority by not condemning the strikes. Defa Press separately argued a legal framework on countering foreign interference is a necessity.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure and detentions
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iranian authorities flogged two women detained during January's protests 31 times each, that strategic fuel reserves are at 'red alert' and could be exhausted within weeks amid Pezeshkian–IRGC disagreement, and that Newsmax cited a US law enforcement source alleging an Iranian plot to kill Yair Netanyahu in Florida. The family of a detained British couple urged the UK to arrange an urgent consular visit following the embassy's return to Tehran.

events.title_en: Cancellation of Zionist official's visa by Canada. The Zionist newspaper Haaretz reports: Canada has cancelled the visa of the deputy mayor of occupied Jerusalem. This decision was taken due to Aryeh King's activities in seizing Palestinians' homes and his campaign against the UN relief and employment agency for Palestinian refugees. King has directly participated in a campaign to dispossess Palestinians of their homes and lands in occupied Jerusalem and has worked to expel Palestinian families from their neighbourhoods and replace them with settlers. Some Zionist officials previously also had entry to certain countries prohibited due to their statements and actions against Palestinians

events.title_en: Congratulatory message from Zohran Mamdani, Mayor of New York, on the occasion of the birthday of the Prophet of Islam. Mamdani: May the birth of the Prophet Muhammad be blessed to the Muslims of New York City and around the world. Today, we honour the life and lasting legacy of Prophet Muhammad, whose teachings of compassion, generosity, justice, faith and service have inspired communities for more than 1,400 years. Here in New York City, his example reminds us that caring for one another, embracing diversity and serving our communities make us stronger in our efforts to build a better city for all. To all those celebrating this day, we wish joy, peace and blessings.

Esteemed and respected champion of the pen and media, His Excellency Hajj Hossein Shariatmadari, peace be upon you. In the school of the Qur'an, a faithful reminder is not a cause of hurt, but a sign of brotherhood, as Almighty God has said: 'And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.' Therefore, I receive your reminder not as confrontation, but from the standpoint of a religious, revolutionary and tested brotherhood in the field

events.title_en: Brigadier Mohebbian: America dropped to its knees to open the Strait. The spokesperson of the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps said: America, in order to reopen the Strait of Hormuz which was previously open, received support from land, sea and air, and despite heavy expenditure and requests for help from NATO and European countries, was unable to achieve this goal. After that, America requested help from NATO and European countries to form a consensus to help it, but this measure also did not succeed. A victory against an enemy with this capability and history must be recorded in history and the people must believe in this victory, because this is a real matter and it is not supposed to promote an unreal reality.

events.title: Will Mojtaba Khamenei's absence help the Islamic Republic survive?

events.title_en: Telegraph: Trump's economic campaign against Iran is doomed to fail. The Telegraph newspaper, in a report criticising the policy of the Donald Trump administration towards Iran, wrote: The campaign called 'Day of Economic Day' to force Tehran to surrender, before compelling Iran to back down, could undermine political support within America for war. This report ultimately writes that Trump faces two difficult options: accepting defeat and reaching an agreement on Iran's terms, or entering a long, costly and bloody war that could affect his presidency and even ultimately lead to another defeat.

events.title_en: Why is the law on countering foreign interference a necessity? At a time when foreign interference and intervention can affect the national interests of countries through political, economic, media and intelligence channels, having a clear legal framework to counter foreign interference is a necessity. The principle of having a legal framework to counter foreign interference is defensible. No country can remain indifferent to the efforts of foreign actors to influence its political, economic, security or social structures. Just as many countries have mechanisms to counter foreign interference, unauthorised transfer of sensitive information or financing of political activities by foreign governments

events.title: The Israeli Air Force bombed a Hamas site in the northern Gaza Strip yesterday, which the IDF says was located next to a hospital and school. The facility in Jabalia had served Hamas as an "ambush position," as well as to store weapons, according to the military. The IDF says that recently, Hamas planned attacks and worked to restore the terror group's capabilities from the building. The strike killed several Hamas operatives, according to the army. The military says the "ambush position" was located some 50 meters from the military's "Yellow Line" in the area, and therefore it had "posed a threat to IDF troops operating in the area." It was also located some 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospi

The Israeli Air Force bombed a Hamas site in the northern Gaza Strip yesterday, which the IDF says was located next to a hospital and school.

The facility in Jabalia had served Hamas as an "ambush position," as well as to store weapons, according to the military. The IDF says that recently, Hamas planned attacks and worked to restore the terror group's capabilities from the building.

The strike killed several Hamas operatives, according to the army.

events.summary: At 10 a.m., the Security Council will hold an open briefing on “the situation in the Middle East, including the Palestinian question”. Deputy Special Coordinator and Resident Coordinator at the Office of the UN Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process Ramiz Alakbarov, and Board of Peace High Representative for Gaza Nickolay Mladenov, are expected to brief, as is a civil society representative. events.title: Iran plotted to assassinate Netanyahu’s son in Florida – Newsmax
events.summary: Iran allegedly plotted to assassinate Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s eldest son, Yair, while he was living in South Florida, Newsmax reported on Wednesday, citing a US law enforcement source familiar with the matter.

events.title: Family of detained British couple in Iran urges UK action after embassy return
events.summary: The family of a British couple detained in Iran called on the UK government on Wednesday to arrange an urgent consular visit and medical checks, saying British diplomats had yet to see them since the embassy returned to the country last week.

events.title: Pakistan, Oman mediation visits are White House deception operation – Kayhan
events.summary: Recent visits to Tehran by regional mediators were part of a White House “deception operation,” the hardline Kayhan newspaper said on Wednesday, following separate visits by Pakistani Army Chief Asim Munir and Omani Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi.

events.title: Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations
events.summary: The Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is indefinitely suspending five general licenses issued pursuant to the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations to align with changes in the foreign policy of the United States towards Iran.
